Definition: Lud, the name of two nations
BiblicalUsage: Lud was a son of Shem, named among the peoples spread out after the flood, and his name stands for a nation of bowmen. Isaiah says God will send those who escape to Lud and the far nations, so they declare His glory among the Gentiles. Ezekiel pictures the men of Lud as warriors in the army of Tyre, hanging shield and helmet in her ranks.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Lud shows God's reach: a people named in a genealogy becomes a people who hear His glory, and no nation is beyond His sending.
